name: reel-prompt
title: Prompt typed
description: A prompt typed into an app's message box, then the send button pressed (reel-05 beat 7)

CHIP.description: The pill title at the top of the stage, e.g. "STEP 1"

CHIP_SMALL.description: Smaller text after it, e.g. "· Kapso"

SIZE.description: Prompt font size; lower it for long prompts

BG.description: "bg" draws the navy stage panel over the top half; "none" leaves it clear

example.PROMPT: Mere business ke liye WhatsApp agent banao jo bookings sambhale
